SELECT sf.id, sf.human_name, sf.flow_ns,
       COALESCE(sf.content_description, '') as content_description,
       COALESCE(sf.usage_condition, '') as usage_condition,
       sf.tenant_id, sf.stage_id,
       COALESCE(sf.media_type, '') as media_type,
       COALESCE(sf.slug_id, '') as slug_id,
       fs.display_name as stage_name, fs.slug as stage_slug
FROM api.stage_flows sf
LEFT JOIN api.funnel_stages fs ON sf.stage_id = fs.id
ORDER BY fs.position, sf.human_name;
SELECT id, display_name, slug, position FROM api.funnel_stages ORDER BY position;

UPDATE api.stage_flows
SET content_description = '{{ $json.body.content_description }}',
usage_condition = '{{ $json.body.usage_condition }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.body.id }}'::uuid;

INSERT INTO api.stage_flows
  (tenant_id, stage_id, flow_ns, human_name, media_type, content_description, usage_condition, slug_id, weight, is_active)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.body.tenant_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.body.stage_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.body.flow_ns }}',
  '{{ $json.body.human_name }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.body.media_type }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.body.content_description }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.body.usage_condition }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.body.slug_id }}', ''),
  1,
  true
);
